name: Snow Crystal
description: A snowflake grown from a seed with six-fold symmetry, for identicons, decoration or a loader.

props.name: seed
props.description: Every seed grows a different crystal: a stellar dendrite, a fern, a plate or a star, with its own branches and tips. Pass a name to use it as an identicon.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height in pixels. Below about 56 pixels the finest twigs are left out, and below 36 only the two longest branch pairs remain, so the crystal stays readable at 24.

props.name: complexity
props.description: From 1 (a spine with a branch pair) to 5 (many branches with twigs and tip plates).

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Width of the spines in pixels. Side branches and twigs are a little finer. Defaults to a width that suits the size, from 1.25 to 3.5.

props.name: animate
props.description: Grow the crystal from the centre outward, branch by branch, over about 1.5 seconds. Regrows when the seed changes. Shown complete under reduced motion.

props.name: spin
props.description: Turn slowly, once every nine seconds, for use as a loader. Still under reduced motion.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Without it the crystal is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the svg. The colour is currentColor. Other svg props are passed through.
